title: [Master]-For an Item of 'Type' Service or Non-Inventory we allow you to increase the Quantity of the Corrective Credit Memo which then if posted updates the Purchase Order with a negative Received and Invoiced values
summary: Purchase order correction now allows quantity increases for Service and Non-Inventory items, which updates the purchase order with negative received and invoiced values when the corrective credit memo is posted.
key_points: Service and Non-Inventory item types can now have their corrective credit memo quantities increased
Posting the corrected invoice updates the purchase order with negative received and invoiced values
Changes applied across multiple localization layers for consistent behavior
Test coverage added to validate the new functionality
